# GamerDex

> GamerDex is a set of free game progress trackers. Each tracker is a standalone web app built for one game. There is no account, progress is saved in the browser, and cloud sync is optional.

Each tracker covers its game's content: collectibles, buildings, upgrades, milestones and completion checklists. Some trackers can sync progress to the player's own Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or GitHub account. GamerDex runs no database of player data.

## Trackers

- [Dinkum Tracker](https://dinkum.gamerdex.app): track fish, bugs, NPCs, recipes, gear and collections in the Australian life sim
- [Stardew Valley Companion](https://stardew-valley.gamerdex.app): track bundles, collections, villagers and perfection, and import a save file
- [Supermarket Simulator Buddy](https://supermarket-simulator.gamerdex.app): track store licenses, products and management progress
- [Whiteout Survival Tracker](https://whiteout-survival.gamerdex.app): track chiefs, buildings, heroes, research and events, and plan upgrade costs and times
- [Clash of Clans Tracker](https://coc.gamerdex.app): track villages, upgrades and queues, dailies, achievements and the Builder Base and Clan Capital
